markdown:
## The SDR Challenge

SDR roles combine high volume, high turnover (average 39% annually), and high impact on revenue. Building a sustainable SDR hiring engine is critical for growth companies.

### The SDR Profile

Successful SDRs share:

- Resilience and rejection tolerance
- Coachability and learning agility
- Competitive drive
- Strong verbal communication
- Discipline and work ethic

### Experience Requirements

Consider carefully:

- 0-2 years often sufficient
- Restaurant, retail experience valuable
- College athletes often excel
- Prior sales experience helpful, not required

### Assessment Methods

Hiring in Sales?

See how subscription sourcing delivers pre-screened sales candidates in as little as 14 days.

[Explore Sales solutions](/industries/sales)

Beyond interviews:

- Role-play cold calls
- Written email exercises
- Personality assessments (DISC, etc.)
- Work sample tests
- Group assessment centers

### Compensation Structures

Market benchmarks:

- Base: $45K-$55K
- OTE: $70K-$85K
- Variable: 30-40% of total
- Accelerators for overperformance

### Training for Success

Set new SDRs up:

- 2-week structured ramp
- Call shadowing and reverse shadowing
- Script certification
- Tool training (CRM, sequences)
- Ongoing coaching cadence

### Measuring SDR Hiring Success

Track:

- Ramp time to quota
- 90-day retention
- Pipeline generated per hire
- Manager satisfaction scores
- Promotion rates

### The TaaS SDR Program

We source high-volume SDR candidates weekly, pre-screened for the traits that predict success. Learn more about our Sales practice on our dedicated industry page.

Building an SDR team is a marathon, not a sprint. Systematic hiring is the only sustainable approach.
